text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Suzuka's speed is terrifying! And Air<n>Groove's
intensity is absolutely<n>suffocating! Even Bright—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! This isn't about them! I<n>have to focus on
myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The weak girl hiding in everyone's<n>shadow is
gone! I'm leaving her<n>behind in this race!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to win! I'll prove it! I'll<n>prove who
Mejiro Dober really is!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (How strange... I can't hear the<n>crowd at all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It's so quiet. But...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My chest feels like it's about to<n>burst. My heart is
pounding so fast<n>and hard.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh... I get it. It's because—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Right now, I'm racing against my<n>peers...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (My rival, who is also seeking her<n>own legacy...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (And my role model, who has guided<n>me so far...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I want to beat all of them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to win! I have to! I have to<n>prove my
strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone that I'm the<n>best—the strongest!
I'm turning the<n>page on my past and starting a new
chapter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Another Mejiro legacy will be forged<n>today! Today I
become... Mejiro<n>Dober!
choice_data_list: You managed to come to terms with yourself.
You managed to come to terms with yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yeah. I did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I faced myself head-on and found my<n>true self in
the process.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So... I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I have another request.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race in the Queen Elizabeth<n>II Cup next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I heard that Air Groove is also going<n>to run in it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I want to race against her there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of Air Groove who gave<n>me so much,
and for the ideal she led<n>me to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge and defeat her...<n>Only then can I
become Mejiro<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This decisive race will be held in the<n>fall at the
honorable Queen Elizabeth<n>II Cup, where peerless
queens all<n>gather to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To ensure Mejiro Dober will be more<n>than ready
for the cup, we decide to<n>set the Fuchu
Umamusume Stakes as<n>a midpoint goal.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, we set out on our path<n>together.
